body:
| Attr | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `title` (alias: `label`) | — | Small uppercase eyebrow above the value. |
| `value` | — | The big number / text — any string. |
| `delta` | — | Change indicator. `+` prefix → up/green, `-` → down/red. `0` / no sign → flat/muted. |
| `description` (alias: `caption`) | — | Secondary muted caption below the delta. |
| `intent` | auto | Override tone: `success` / `warn` / `danger` / `info` / `muted` / `primary`. Used when "down is good" (e.g. latency). |
| `trend` | auto | Override arrow only: `up` / `down` / `flat`. |
| `href` | — | Wrap the card in a link. Renders a hover ring. |
